Exact App665 / LCD DE3.92 simulator source binding
=================================================
Firmware production commit: 73df4e3d16f0e51b3bbd3e9bf10387010ed32934
Firmware final validation commit: 05028b679591e3d228f2b43c6057e3905f5cca88
Firmware SourceID: 49ed45a809f197c9d3b072bf1cb243fd8cf0b62fa55826d2cfeda841afe767b9
Engine SHA256: 605356ff74646392adcfb26adf5c7d39fe7138272e84b4e4a0f167b94e34c2c1
WASM SHA256: 08428602391b6d9f8ee1bfb28abf683a5a774b97d75242da70d8d0f2f6314d16

Only this new profile uses WASI SDK 34.0 for Linux x86_64, with Clang
23.1.0-wasi-sdk (LLVM commit 895aa2c896ada719451be2e3673c83da8ddf1141).
The previous profiles retain their original Clang 23.1.4 compiler/output gates.
The SDK is obtained from the official WebAssembly/wasi-sdk project:
https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/tag/wasi-sdk-34
https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-34/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
Archive SHA256: b761e3a0721dbae9c09a0059e5fdb2bf917d1b4a8a7b430fb3b5aafb0984b2c4
Compiler and linker binary hashes and exact versions: SOURCE_BINDING.json.
The compiler is not included. Verify the archive hash before extracting it.

Reproduce from the root of the extracted source archive:
  python3 web/scripts/build-capacity-de392.py --sdk /path/to/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux --output /path/to/new-evidence-directory
The dedicated builder checks compiler/linker binary hashes and versions,
all source hashes, the engine identity, and exact output bytes. It disables
SDK default config explicitly and compares against the shipped WASM.
No old profile or historical compiler check is changed by this new builder.

The six core/LittleFS files are byte-identical to the frozen App665 firmware.
The RAM-only simulation harness and freestanding helpers are retained from
the private App664 profile. Source hashes cover the full 12-file source set.
The same pinned engine passed a 1,208-entry synthetic import/readback and
six cross-mount phases with App664, including read-only NOR-write checks.
Qualification also executes the linked ARM layout routine from the actual
App665 ELF. See docs/validation/DE3_92_PFS.json in the full source package.

The simulator executes no device operations. Its capacity estimate does
not establish physical free space, power-cut safety or hardware acceptance.
Application transfers still require the separate signed OTA package.

License notices are included as GPL-2.0-LICENSE and LITTLEFS-LICENSE.md.
